title: semicraft.su
description:
Cool alpha style server!
Nothing scary.
body:
[![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8890cd7605041cc12232a37c3584b37d82f1e7da.png)
](https://semicraft.su)On June 2, 2015, I, HanoiHaze, opened the SemiCraft server.

The first players started joining the server and building a spawn.

But a few months later, a bug occurred in the code, and I lost almost all control of the server.

Players started noticing something strange.

I decided to close the server, but reopened it in 2020. After the strange behavior reappeared, I closed the server and reopened it in 2026.

The server is currently whitelisted. To join, you need to email me (more information can be found on semicraft.su).
-  mahazeviet@gmail.com
